# AE Tax Advisors for Real Estate Investors
> Tax planning and cost segregation services for real estate investors, including STR and LTR strategies.

## About
AE Tax Advisors for Real Estate Investors details how AE Tax Advisors helps real estate investors minimize taxes through cost segregation studies, bonus depreciation under IRC 168(k), the short-term rental tax loophole under Treas. Reg. 1.469-1T(e)(3)(ii)(A), passive activity loss planning under IRC Section 469, and Form 3115 catch-up depreciation. Services cover both short-term rental (Airbnb/VRBO) and long-term rental property owners.
